task.description: Three read sites in benchwork point at .rabbet/spool/outbox.jsonl, which no writer has produced since the spool moved to .gaugeblock/spool/outbox.jsonl: hub_service.rs line 69 (pending traces panel), line 100 (delete a trace by id, which would therefore never find its target), and capabilities.rs line 139 (scan_telemetry count). The directory does not exist, so all three return zero while the real outbox holds 15 records. The only correct path builder in benchwork is chat_harness::telemetry_spool::spool_outbox_path, which the chat orchestrator uses for spool_silver_sft and spool_gold_dpo. Fix by routing all four sites through that one function, and ideally through GaugeblockPaths once CO-7 lands so the rule exists once for the suite.
task.title: benchwork reads a dead legacy spool path, so its telemetry panel and counters always show zero

receipt.summary: all three benchwork read sites now use spool_outbox_path and parse SpoolEntry envelopes; 4 regression tests green plus clippy and fmt; panel and capability counter now agree and delete removes exactly one record
